newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-HELISSIO IN REPEAT SAINT-CLOUD BID.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-HELISSIO IN REPEAT SAINT-CLOUD BID.

text.p: French superstar racehorse Helissio is to have his next outing in the group one Grand Prix de Saint-Cloud in Paris on June 29.
The news was confirmed on Thursday by trainer Elie Lellouche whose charge will be out to repeat his 1996 win in the mile and a half (2.4 km) event.
Helissio made a stunning start to the campaign when spreadeagling a high class field in the group one Prix Ganay at Longchamp in April.
The colt was forced to miss a much awaited re-match with Japan Cup winner Singspiel in the Coronation Cup at Epsom earlier this month owing to illness.
But British racegoers may get an opportunity to see the top rated European horse of 1996 in action at Ascot next month.
The runaway Arc de Triomphe winner is part of a high class entry of 38 for the King George VI and Queen Elizabeth Diamond Stakes on July 26.
Helissio's long term goal is a repeat of his Arc de Triomphe success on October 5.
